status: Research lore for the tool-using Ask (agents/ask_tools.py tool_nakshatra). Classical Moon-in-star traits from Brihat Jataka ch.XVI; rows with classical_checked_in_print false (Ashwini to Punarvasu) were not found in the OCR and must be verified against the printed book. story_gloss is modern deity-story practice (tier H), never classical.
rules: Predict by the Moon's strength: weak Moon = faint traces of the star's traits; strong Moon = full.
Moon, its sign and the sign lord all strong = portrait fully holds; two of three = partly; one = traces; none = nothing.
Hasta, Swati, Vishakha and Shatabhisha have two readings; never present one as certain.
Classically only the Moon's star has trait verses; for Lagna and other planets the star is colour (deity, lord, story), and must be called practice.
